facts.claim: Claude Ship is available in beta and can review PRs, fix them, and decide what is ready to merge based on team policies.
facts.verbatim_support: available today in beta. It can review PRs, fix them, and decide what's ready to merge based on policies each team sets.

facts.claim: Claude Ship is made of Code Review plus two new beta agents: PR Steward and Claude Approvals.
facts.verbatim_support: Claude Ship is made up of Code Review, which is already generally available, and two new agents in beta: PR Steward and Claude Approvals.

facts.claim: Code Review posts categorized findings to the pull request.
facts.verbatim_support: collects findings, adversarially verifies them, categorizes them, and posts them to a PR

facts.claim: PR Steward works on failing CI checks, merge conflicts and review feedback, and is designed not to approve or merge pull requests.
facts.verbatim_support: designed not to approve or merge pull requests. It jumps in on failing CI checks, merge conflicts, and review feedback

facts.claim: Claude Approvals applies an approval policy the team writes as a file in the repository.
facts.verbatim_support: applies an approval policy that the team writes as a file in the repository

facts.claim: Developers can run /ship in Claude Code; Claude pushes the change, opens the PR, reviews it, and works on feedback and failing checks.
facts.verbatim_support: they run /ship. Claude pushes it, opens the PR, reviews the change, and works on feedback and failing checks

facts.claim: Claude Ship is available on Claude Team and Enterprise plans for repositories on GitHub.
facts.verbatim_support: Claude Ship is available on Claude Team and Enterprise plans for repositories on GitHub.
